title: Charged Creepers
description: Adds dynamic natural spawning for Charged Creepers. The spawn rate increases on Hard and reaches 8% in Hardcore for an extreme challenge!
body:
# ⚡ Charged Creepers — Pure Hardcore Challenge!

Tired of never seeing **Charged Creepers** in your vanilla world? Want to turn your nighttime hunting into a real adrenaline rush? 

**Charged Creepers** is a lightweight, ultra-optimized server-side mod that introduces **natural spawning** for these electric monsters. No more waiting for lucky lightning strikes—now they roam free in the dark, and their numbers scale directly with your world's difficulty!

---

## 🎯 Features & Game Balance

This mod dynamically hooks into Minecraft's spawn system and adjusts the challenge depending on your playstyle:

* 🌸 **Peaceful:** **0%** — Safe and clean. No creepers spawn, zero CPU impact.
* 🪵 **Easy:** **1%** — A tiny, shocking surprise for beginners (approx. 1 in 100).
* 🛡️ **Normal:** **3%** — The perfect vanilla+ experience (approx. 1 in 33).
* ⚔️ **Hard:** **6%** — Elite threat. Surviving the night requires real skill (approx. 1 in 16).
* 💀 **Hardcore Mode:** **8%** — Ultimate punishment! Almost 1 out of 12 creepers will spawn with a deadly blue electric aura. One mistake can end your entire Hardcore run forever!

---

## 🚀 True Server-Side Optimization

We care about your performance. This mod is built from scratch for **NeoForge 1.21.x** with pure efficiency in mind:
* **0% TPS Drops:** No heavy loops, no laggy command execution. Code runs instantly only when a mob spawns.
* **Server-Side Only:** Players don't need to install this mod to join your server! Perfect for vanilla public servers and private SMPs.
* **Bug-Free Logic:** Strict server-side verification ensures no phantom entities or visual glitches.
